_doc: Exploratory questions for the agent, run with `node server/scripts/eval.js --probe`. Nothing here is asserted: every reply is printed (with its chips, retrieval and unanswered flag) for a human to read, to find reasoning errors the regression set in questions.json doesn't cover. Each probe is a conversation: `turns` are sent in order, each with the replies so far. When a probe exposes a real bug, fix it and add a checked case to questions.json.
